title: OceanBase：金融级分布式关系数据库
abstract: OceanBase 是蚂蚁集团自研的金融级分布式关系数据库，支持海量数据、高并发事务处理与分析，采用 Paxos 多副本强一致协议与原生分布式架构，在 TPC-C 与 TPC-H 测试中刷新世界纪录。

title: Spanner: Google's Globally-Distributed Database
abstract: Spanner is Google's scalable, multi-version, globally-distributed database. It is the first system to distribute data at global scale and support externally-consistent distributed transactions, using the TrueTime API and Paxos replication.

title: Paxos Made Live: An Engineering Perspective
abstract: We describe our experience building Chubby, a fault-tolerant distributed lock service built on the Paxos consensus algorithm, and the engineering challenges of making Paxos work in production.

title: The Google File System
abstract: We describe the Google File System, a scalable distributed file system for large distributed data-intensive applications, providing fault tolerance while running on inexpensive commodity hardware.

title: MapReduce: Simplified Data Processing on Large Clusters
abstract: MapReduce is a programming model and an associated implementation for processing and generating large data sets with a parallel, distributed algorithm on a large cluster of commodity machines.

title: Bigtable: A Distributed Storage System for Structured Data
abstract: Bigtable is a distributed storage system for managing structured data designed to scale to a very large size across thousands of commodity servers, used by many Google products.

title: The Log-Structured Merge-Tree (LSM-Tree)
abstract: The log-structured merge-tree is a disk-based data structure designed to provide low-cost indexing for files experiencing high rates of record insertion and deletion over long periods.

title: RocksDB: A Tunable High-Performance Persistent Key-Value Store
tags: 存储引擎;嵌入式数据库
abstract: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage, based on LevelDB, optimized to exploit flash and RAM storage, with tunable write and read performance.

title: Memory Consistency Models: A Tutorial
abstract: A tutorial on shared-memory consistency models, from sequential consistency to relaxed models, showing how memory models affect correctness of parallel programs.

title: ARIES: A Transaction Recovery Method Supporting Fine-Granularity Locking
abstract: ARIES is a recovery method that exploits the semantics of locking and write-ahead logging to support fine-granularity locking and partial rollbacks while retaining simplicity and performance.

title: ScyllaDB：基于分片感知的高吞吐 NoSQL 数据库实践
abstract: 介绍 ScyllaDB 如何利用分片感知（shard-aware）架构与现代多核硬件实现每节点数百万 OPS 的键值吞吐，并与 Cassandra 数据模型兼容。

title: HTAP 数据库综述：事务与分析混合负载的处理技术
abstract: 综述 HTAP（混合事务/分析处理）数据库的关键技术：事务型行存与列存副本、数据同步机制、查询优化与资源隔离，并比较 OceanBase、TiDB 等系统的 HTAP 实现路径。

title: Serializable Isolation for Snapshot Databases
abstract: A survey of serializable isolation in snapshot databases, covering SSI, TICTOC and other algorithms that detect write skews among concurrent transactions.

title: CALM: Consistency as Logical Monotonicity
abstract: The CALM principle connects logical monotonicity to distributed consistency, showing that monotone programs can be computed without coordination, providing foundations for eventual consistency.

title: TiDB：分布式 NewSQL 数据库的设计与实践
abstract: TiDB 是开源分布式 NewSQL 数据库，组合 TiKV 事务键值层与 TiFlash 列存副本，支持 Raft 多副本复制与 HTAP 混合负载。

title: Dynamo: Amazon's Highly Available Key-value Store
abstract: Dynamo is Amazon's highly available key-value store relying on eventual consistency, consistent hashing and vector clocks, serving millions of requests for the shopping cart at peak.

title: Kafka: a Distributed Messaging System for Log Processing
abstract: We describe Kafka, a distributed messaging system for log processing, achieving high throughput by batching, sequential IO and a partitioned commit log design.

title: Consistent Hashing and Random Trees
abstract: We introduce consistent hashing, a distribution scheme that minimizes data movement when nodes join or leave, and apply it to relieve hot spots in distributed caching.

title: ZooKeeper: Wait-free Coordination for Internet-scale Systems
abstract: ZooKeeper is a coordination service for distributed systems providing wait-free ordering guarantees, implemented with Zab, an atomic broadcast protocol.

title: MVCC 多版本并发控制机制深度解析
abstract: 解析 PostgreSQL 与 InnoDB 中 MVCC 的实现差异：版本链、xmin/xmax、可见性判断规则、快照隔离与 vacuum 清理机制，说明 MVCC 如何提升只读事务的并发度。

title: Attention Is All You Need
abstract: We propose the Transformer, a new architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely, achieving state-of-the-art machine translation quality.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
abstract: BERT obtains new state-of-the-art results on eleven NLP tasks by pre-training deep bidirectional representations with masked language modeling and next sentence prediction.

title: Language Models are Few-Shot Learners
abstract: We train GPT-3, a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model, and show that scaling improves few-shot performance dramatically, enabling in-context learning without gradient updates.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP Tasks
abstract: We explore RAG, a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe combining pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory, retrieving Wikipedia passages to ground generation in evidence.

title: 检索增强生成技术综述：大模型如何利用外部知识
abstract: 综述检索增强生成（RAG）的核心链路：文档切分、向量嵌入、相似度检索、重排序与生成，比较朴素 RAG、高级 RAG 与模块化 RAG 的架构差异，并讨论评测方法。

title: Embedding 技术全景：从词向量到多模态表示学习
abstract: 系统梳理嵌入（Embedding）技术的发展脉络：word2vec、GloVe、句向量、SimCSE 到大规模检索模型的双塔结构，并介绍向量相似度度量与 ANN 索引的基础知识。

title: 近似最近邻搜索算法比较研究
abstract: 比较主流近似最近邻搜索算法：IVF 倒排文件索引、HNSW 分层可导航小世界图、PQ 乘积量化在召回率、延迟与内存之间的权衡，并给出工程选型建议。

title: HNSW: Hierarchical Navigable Small World Graphs
abstract: HNSW is a graph-based ANN index organizing vectors into a hierarchical navigable small world graph, achieving state-of-the-art recall-latency trade-off for billion-scale vector search.

title: Faiss: A Library for Efficient Similarity Search
abstract: Faiss is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors, with GPU implementations of IVF, PQ and HNSW indexes used widely in ML pipelines.

title: 文本向量检索中的重排序技术综述
abstract: 介绍检索两阶段架构中的重排序（Rerank）技术：交叉编码器打分、列表式学习排序（Learning to Rank）、ColBERT 延迟交互等方法及其延迟-效果权衡。

title: RAG 系统中的文档切分策略研究
abstract: 讨论 RAG 场景下文档切分（Chunking）策略对检索质量的影响：固定长度、递归字符、语义切分与父子块检索，并给出不同语料类型的推荐配置。

title: 提示工程：面向大语言模型的提示词方法与实践
abstract: 总结提示工程的核心方法：零样本/少样本提示、思维链（Chain-of-Thought）、自洽性（Self-Consistency）与 ReAct 框架，并讨论提示词的鲁棒性与评测。

title: Evaluating RAG Systems: Metrics and Benchmarks
abstract: A practical guide to evaluating retrieval-augmented systems: context precision and recall, faithfulness, answer relevance, and end-to-end benchmarks like RGB and RAGAS.

title: Multimodal Retrieval: Text-Image Joint Embedding Methods
abstract: We survey joint text-image embedding methods including CLIP and ALIGN, and their application to multimodal retrieval, zero-shot classification and cross-modal search.

title: Agentic AI 与工具调用：让大模型学会使用工具
abstract: 介绍基于大模型的智能体（Agent）范式：ReAct 循环、函数调用（Function Calling）、规划与反思机制，以及 MCP（Model Context Protocol）等工具接入标准。

title: Model Context Protocol: 开放工具接入标准与生态实践
abstract: MCP 是一个开放协议，规范了大模型应用与外部工具、数据源之间的连接方式，支持文件、数据库、API 等资源的标准化访问，已成为 Agent 生态的重要基础设施。

title: OceanBase seekdb：面向 AI 应用的向量与全文混合检索数据库
abstract: seekdb 是 OceanBase 推出的 AI 原生数据库，支持向量索引（IVF）、全文倒排索引（ik 分词）与关系过滤的单引擎融合，通过 RRF 融合排序实现语义与关键词混合检索，提供嵌入式 Python SDK（pyseekdb）。

title: PowerContext：面向 AI Agent 的项目上下文服务
abstract: PowerContext 把工作中值得长期保留的部分（已确认的决定、约束、证据、进展）从对话中搬到独立的上下文服务层，提供 Memory、Handoff、Experience、Skill 四类服务，支持跨会话、跨 Agent 续接工作。

title: The Design of a Practical System for Fault-Tolerant Virtual Machines
abstract: We present the design of a fault-tolerant virtual machine system that maintains a backup on another host using continuous checkpointing and a logging channel.

title: Erasure Coding vs. Replication: A Storage Cost Perspective
abstract: We analyze the storage overhead of erasure coding versus replication in distributed storage systems and quantify repair traffic trade-offs.

title: 分布式缓存架构：从缓存穿透到多级缓存
abstract: 讨论分布式缓存的核心问题：缓存穿透、击穿与雪崩的应对，热点 key 治理，一致性策略（旁路/读写穿透），以及本地缓存加分布式缓存的多级架构设计。

title: Leases: An Efficient Fault-Tolerant Mechanism for File Cache Consistency
abstract: We introduce leases, a mechanism that provides efficient and robust cache consistency in distributed file systems by time-limiting guarantees.

title: 无锁编程：无锁数据结构与 CAS 原子操作实践
abstract: 讲解无锁编程的基本原理：CAS/LL-SC 原子操作、ABA 问题、内存序与发布规则，并实现无锁栈、队列与链表等经典数据结构。

title: The Tail at Scale
abstract: This paper describes why high-latency tails matter at service scale and presents request-level techniques such as hedged requests, tie-breakers and selective replication to curb variability.

title: LSM-tree Compaction 调度优化研究
abstract: We study compaction scheduling policies for LSM-tree storage engines, modeling write amplification, space amplification and read amplification trade-offs under tiered and leveled policies.

title: io_uring: 现代 Linux 异步 IO 接口设计与性能分析
abstract: io_uring is a modern Linux asynchronous IO interface using shared submission and completion queues, eliminating syscall overhead for high-performance storage and network applications.

title: Scaling Memcache at Facebook
abstract: We describe the evolution of Memcached deployment at Facebook to handle billions of requests per second, covering lease mechanism, hot key handling and pool architectures.

title: 云数据库存算分离架构与 RDMA 网络
abstract: 介绍云数据库中的存算分离架构：RDMA 网络下的远程共享存储、计算无状态化与故障恢复路径，以 PolarDB、Aurora 为例分析性能与成本收益。
